picks.editorial_note: NSF's $1.5 billion X-Labs initiative adds a dedicated funding track for AI applied to physical systems, signaling a major national bet on AI-driven breakthroughs across science and engineering.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: A $15 million gift from the OpenAI Foundation to UCSF's OpenADMET Consortium will build open pharmacokinetic datasets specifically to train better drug-behavior prediction models, pairing industry AI funding with open science infrastructure.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: NSF's new ELEGANT program aims to translate lab-scale semiconductor research into domestic manufacturing platforms, a strategic move to secure the chip supply underpinning U.S. AI compute capacity.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: SRI's $26.5 million ARPA-H award funds an AI 'co-pilot' bringing specialist-level guidance to rural medical care, a concrete example of federally-backed AI translating into real-world healthcare access.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's new AWS-powered Innovation Hub represents a deep academic-industry-clinical alliance aimed at operationalizing AI in medical education and care delivery.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: An international team's new protein language model unifying sequence and 3D structure data offers a significant scientific advance for mapping evolutionary and functional relationships across the protein universe.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission-funded project applying AI to decades of nuclear waste safety data illustrates how the federal government is directing AI toward high-stakes regulatory and environmental challenges.
picks.title: AI project reviews nuclear waste safety-case evidence

picks.editorial_note: FAU's 'Hovering Owls' were among only two university teams to clear DARPA's demanding Lift Challenge payload threshold, demonstrating competitive, defense-relevant advances in autonomous aerial systems.
picks.title: FAU CA-AI Hovering Owls Excel at DARPA Lift Challenge

picks.editorial_note: EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS's open-source Apertus model reaching tens of millions of users through Proton's Lumo assistant is a rare case of academic open-source AI achieving major consumer-scale deployment.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: Stony Brook's Yi Liu is advancing generative diffusion models for molecular design alongside a Brookhaven National Lab collaboration on battery materials, linking fundamental AI research to national lab-scale materials science.
picks.title: Liu Leads Research Projects on Molecular Design, Battery Design
